description.describe_ch: In the Innovation Project 1 and 2 (Design-driven Innovation 1 and 2) course, students develop research skills that support an innovation mindset and the competencies required to implement a design-driven innovation process. During this course, students are introduced to innovation theories and useful frameworks that explain the incremental and radical innovation of products, services, and experiences. Students then learn to explore the socio-cultural contexts and factors that underlie a design situation to frame a problem to solve or a potential opportunity, and create a design approach that leads to true novelty. To achieve this, students work in teams to conduct crucial design research, develop and communicate a design framework, prototype the proposed innovation, and produce a video depicting the innovation’s benefits in context.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
Please be aware of the followings:
1. Missing classes will be penalized in grades. 3-weeks absence (without a reason) will be considered failing the course (Let me know, if you have special condition, I will try to help you to make up for the course)

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Class Regulations: 
1. Please be in the class on time. Attendance will be taken regularly. 
2. Excess absence over 3 weeks with no reason will be automatically considered failing the course. However, exceptional conditions should notice your teacher ASAP.
3. Most grades are based on team effort. As a result, a cross-evaluation within the team will be conducted in the end of the course. Students will be asked to evaluate their team member accordingly. 
4. This course is heavily dependent on class discussion and activity (learning by doing); thus,students who surfing the net will be punished on grades. 
5. No foul language is allowed in the class.
6. Be polite to everyone in the class. 
7. If you use AI or chat.GPT (any sort) to do your assignment or presentation, you need to notice your course teacher. You cannot completely copy the content, please note that plagiarism is not allowed.
